location.boundary_end: Chiplima end of Hirakud-Chiplima main path

primary_boundary.basis: CWC dam flood-risk modelling guidance identifies normal depth or a rating curve as common downstream boundary conditions.
primary_boundary.implementation_note: The normal-depth condition shall use the local downstream channel geometry, bed slope, and Manning roughness associated with the selected hydraulic geometry/roughness case.

rating_curve.reason: No nearby downstream CWC discharge dataset has been retrieved for direct local calibration of the Hirakud-Chiplima reach.
rating_curve.future_upgrade: Replace or supplement the normal-depth boundary if a defensible downstream stage-discharge relationship becomes available.

initial_condition.note: Initial reservoir level and initial hydraulic state must be taken from the individual scenario definition and not invented at the boundary.

geometry_dependency.note: The downstream normal-depth calculation must use the same geometry and roughness case as the hydraulic run.

limitations: Normal depth is a provisional hydraulic boundary assumption, not an observed downstream water level.
No local downstream rating curve is available in the current dataset.
Final solver stability and sensitivity to the downstream boundary must be evaluated during hydraulic model QA.

source_references.document: Guidelines for Mapping Flood Risks Associated with Dams
source_references.note: Guidance identifies normal depth or rating curve as common downstream boundary choices.

next_step: Define simulation duration, hydraulic time step, output interval, and downstream-boundary sensitivity requirements.
